title: pseudechinolaena polystachya
intro: Pseudechinolaena polystachya, commonly known as a type of flowering plant, is a species within the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation.
